Name: Creepy Forest Druid Rasmodius - Wizard Portraits
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[color=#8e7cc3][font=Arial][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/font][/color][font=Arial]
It's the beginning of the Halloween season and I thought, what better way to kick it off than making a spooky portrait mod for Stardew Valley! For a guy that stays hidden away in a tower in the middles of the woods brewing strange potions that make you hallucinate trees, the vanilla Wizard does not nearly look weird and gross enough. This mod fixes that, changing his portraits and sprites into a creepier, weirder version fitting for the season.

Currently does not include seasonal variations but I might revisit the idea sometime in the future.

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
This mod can be installed like normal, by downloading, unzipping, and dropping into your Mods folder. Can be added or removed at any time.[/font]

[font=Arial][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=4]Configuration[/size][/color][/b][/font]
[font=Arial]This mod offers one config option for portrait style, with the two options being Original (art by me) and Nyapu (art by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/sugarsbt]sugarsbt[/url])

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
I have tried to make this mod as compatible as possible with the VERY wide range of Wizard mods that exist out there. Currently, there is compatibility for:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] (specifically the Genderfluid Wizard option)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]Romanceable Rasmodius (all versions)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]Looking for Love (both versions)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22912]Spouse Portraits Reworked[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37083]Vanilla Non-Marriageable NPC Portraits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42218]Vanilla NPC Family and Group Portraits[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16072]The Wizard's New Robes[/url] (through DSV's own compatibility/crossover for that mod)[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Arial]All compatibility (such as number of portraits used) should be handled automatically, using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url] and the configs set in your other Wizard mods. I am sure there are interactions and edge cases that I have missed though, so please report any issues you run into in the Bugs section with a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url].[/font]
[font=Arial]
Not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodious Redux Revamp[/url] (RRRR). I currently have no plans or interest to try to adapt my design to that mod, so do not ask.[/font]


[font=Arial]If you enjoyed this mod, why not check out my [url=https://vinillavin.neocities.org/]neocities[/url]?[/font]
